newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGC predicts 96/97 losses due to low profitability.
newsitem.headline: JGC predicts 96/97 losses due to low profitability.

text.p: Plant engineering firm JGC Corp said on Thursday that it drastically revised down its parent and group earnings forecast for the year to March 31, 1997, due to the lower profitability of some of its projects.
The profitability of some of the projects JGC won after severe competition was found to be lower than JGC initially thought, the company said in a statement.
The profitability of some overseas projects was also expected to fall due to a delay in the projects, it said.

JGC now expects to post parent current loss of 9.5 billion yen in 1996/97 against its previous forecast of parent current profit of 2.5 billion yen. In 1995/96 it posted parent current profit of 6.49 billion yen.
JGC now expects to post group net loss of 9.0 billion yen against its previous forecast of 2.0 billion yen net profit.
It posted group net profit of 2.38 billion yen in 1995/96.
